scope: One sensor-selected native extraction plus matched stationary control. Separate physics extraction, online held association and transition permission. No transfer/insertion/repeated-demo claim.

identity_binding.method: Unique IoU>=0.5 among actual highest remaining physical-layer faces only, independently derived from frozen initial reference layers; no hidden repeated-XY lower faces. Selected measured upper depth must agree within frozen1mm with actual matched body/stud top in TABLE frame. No postmotion reassignment or truth feedback.
identity_binding.clock: Selection and projected-reference packet must have identical initial frame ID and measurement time; only one initial IoU>=0.5 reference may qualify.

native_success.relative_pose_reference: First singleton detachment, every later measured step through final hold; body-root relative to actual TCP, world coordinates.

raw_contact.helpers: Pinned existing signed raw-vector/dt/range/matrix and body/white/head point-classification checks. SUMABS all-partner magnitude; every loaded point at abs(f)>1e-8N. Geometry work only for nonzero loaded frames.
raw_contact.thresholds: contact_protocol.json numeric reporting and 50um ownership tolerances unchanged; pick force/motion thresholds come from frozen scientific protocol.
raw_contact.unavailable_reciprocal: UNMEASURED, never fabricate agreement or interpret zero as completeness.
raw_contact.reciprocal: Two online finger views and one offline-only source view bound once by the unique initial selected-face match. Independently recompute binding; do not expose source paths/IDs to policy. Raw signed reciprocal vectors and ALL loaded source↔finger points checked.
raw_contact.loaded_only_geometry: Skip triangle-distance work only when abs(raw scalar)<=frozen1e-8N; retain raw completeness/dt/matrix checks on every frame, including all-zero frames. Summaries contain counts/maxima rather than verbose point tables.

historical_geometry_scope: Original G remains failed; canonical model/cooked identity and explicit lateral-qualified domain only. No endcap/global-STL pass or hardware force-equivalence claim.
online_hold: Independent physics pass does not establish online held identity; UNKNOWN blocks transfer.
budget_accounting: 600s cumulative per CASE: matched3600-step control capture+audit plus pick capture+audit, prior runtime charged from pinned predecessor pipeline supervisor. Control+pick<=7200steps; no hidden retry/parallel execution. Queue wait excluded.
phase_boundaries: At final-approach and lift transition, commanded waypoint interpolation begins at previous same-row actual TCP pose, as frozen controller specifies; lift stays straight TABLE+Z for5mm from that measured start. No target/body pose write or post-hoc target substitution.
abstention: Completed zero-step sensor abstention has no selected identity, measured load or extraction credit; report ABSTAIN/coverage failure rather than try to score absent contact files.
